consumer: The offline map-dump tool reading the snapshot JSON, asking: what is the ground-truth terrain id occupying each nearby tile in the world?
scope: The raw per-tile authoritative terrain id over the nearby tiles, unfiltered by display/memory/visibility
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles reads ctx.m.ter(p).id().str() (and furn) which returns the map's raw stored terrain id at the tile
divergence: none for the stated goal: a tile the player has not seen (seen=false / outside LOS) still has a real stored terrain that m.ter(p) returns correctly, whereas a display/memory view (class D) would lag or show stale memory; raw m.ter is the right authority
